name: PantryPal
one_liner: Snap a photo of your fridge, get 3 recipes.
problem: Deciding what to cook based on whatever ingredients happen to be in the fridge can be difficult and time-consuming.
audience: People looking for quick recipe ideas based on the ingredients currently in their fridge.

features.name: Ingredient detection from a photo
features.description: Takes a photo of an open fridge and automatically detects visible ingredients.

features.name: Ranked recipe suggestions
features.description: Suggests three recipes ranked by how many of your detected ingredients they use.

features.name: Shopping list
features.description: Provides a shopping list for the missing ingredients needed to complete suggested recipes.
